text.title: 没有写完的值班表
text.situation:
下一周，机器维修期间，米娜考虑如何重组冬季班次。她以前的工作单位曾因订单减少而裁员。她的岗位取消后，她被裁掉，仍记得在拥挤告示板旁收到消息。努尔问，这里是不是也要发生同样的事。米娜说，她还没作出涉及岗位的决定。目前排班表仍有空缺。他们还谈了员工流动：反复换人意味着每次重新培训新人。杰伊才刚熟悉工作。米娜让冬季排班表暂时留白，请两人标出自己能承担的时间。下一次讨论会从这些真实限制开始，而不是一张空表格。

米娜发给杰伊和努尔
请在排班草稿上标出冬季能工作的时间。我们需要一起讨论机器维修、订单数量和柜台班次。这份草稿不是裁员通知。周四关门后一起谈。

paragraphs.en: The following week, while the machine was being repaired, Mina considered how to restructure the winter shifts. At her former workplace, a fall in orders had led to redundancy. She had been made redundant when her role disappeared, and she remembered receiving the news beside a crowded noticeboard. Noor asked whether the same thing was about to happen here. Mina said she had not made a decision about jobs. The current rota still had gaps. They also discussed staff turnover: replacing people repeatedly meant training each newcomer again. Jay had only recently settled into the work. Mina left the winter schedule unfinished and asked both of them to mark the hours they could manage. The next discussion would begin with those real limits, not an empty set of boxes.

paragraphs.en:
Mina → Jay and Noor
Please mark the winter hours you can work on the draft rota. We need to discuss the machine repair, the number of orders and the counter shifts together. This draft is not a notice of redundancy. Let us meet after closing on Thursday.

S08.Q19.P01.cue: 说说冬季班次计划，以及米娜以前失去工作后的担忧。
acceptableAnswers: 米娜考虑怎样重组冬季班次。 米娜以前因岗位取消被裁员。

S08.Q19.P02.cue: 说说她原单位发生了什么。
acceptableAnswers: 订单减少曾使她原单位裁员。

S08.Q19.P03.cue: 说明反复换员工为什么可能有困难。
acceptableAnswers: 员工流动率高，会意味着不断培训新人。

S08.Q19.T01.cue: 机构不再需要某个岗位，怎样描述当事人失去工作？
acceptableAnswers: 她的岗位取消后被裁员。
